# Hydrogen Compressor (H2Compressor)

> **Class**: `H2Compressor` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hydrogen` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Multi-stage hydrogen compressor with intercooling.

``n_stages`` stages (default 3) share the overall pressure ratio equally,
r = (p_discharge / p_suction)^(1/n_stages). Each stage draws gas at temperature
``t_in_c`` (first stage) or ``t_intercool_c`` (after intercooling) and needs the
isentropic work (ideal gas, constant gamma = 1.41, no compressibility correction)

    w_stage = gamma/(gamma-1) * R_H2 * T_in * (r^((gamma-1)/gamma) - 1) / eta_isen.

``P_elec_kW`` is the total shaft/electric work (no mechanical/motor losses beyond
``isentropic_efficiency``). ``Q_intercool_kW`` is the heat removed in the
``n_stages - 1`` intercoolers (cooling gas from the stage outlet temperature to
``t_intercool_c``); the after-cooler is not counted. Stateless: ``dt`` has no effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'H2Compressor'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `max_flow_kg_hr` | `float` | `500.0` | kg/h | - |
| `p_suction_bar` | `float` | `30.0` | bar | - |
| `p_discharge_bar` | `float` | `350.0` | bar | - |
| `isentropic_efficiency` | `float` | `0.7` | - | - |
| `n_stages` | `int` | `3` | - | - |
| `t_in_c` | `float` | `20.0` | degC | - |
| `t_intercool_c` | `float` | `30.0` | degC | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `m_dot_in_kg_hr` | kg/h | Inlet mass flow rate of hydrogen to compress |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `P_elec_kW` | kW | - |
| `m_dot_out_kg_hr` | kg/h | High-pressure delivery flow rate |
| `Q_intercool_kW` | kW | - |

## Validity and notes

Validity: ideal-gas hydrogen (gamma = 1.41, no compressibility correction), equal stage pressure
ratios, steady-state flow up to max_flow_kg_hr; no start-up or surge behaviour.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import H2Compressor

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('h2compressor', model=H2Compressor(), outputs=['P_elec_kW', 'm_dot_out_kg_hr', 'Q_intercool_kW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['h2compressor'].tail(2))
```
